plainText:
Suzy Myers is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Myers first began to provide voices for in Pokémon Chronicles. As with most other voice actors who worked with 4Kids Entertainment, she left when and TAJ Productions took over the dubbing and distribution of the series. Later, she provided the voice of Normajean in The Brockster Is In!, making her the final former 4Kids voice actor to return to the in . In , she gained two important roles, voicing the Kalos Pokédex and Clemont's Chespin.
